#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create an ICS calendar entry for the Project Kickoff Meeting:
next Monday, 10:00-12:00 in the system's local timezone.
"""
import calendar as _cal
import os
import subprocess
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

OUTPUT = "project_kickoff.ics"
SUMMARY = "Project Kickoff Meeting"
DESCRIPTION = "Kickoff meeting for the new project."
STATUS = "CONFIRMED"


def get_local_tz_name():
    """Best-effort detection of the system's IANA timezone name."""
    try:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
    except ImportError:
        return None
    candidates = []
    try:
        with open("/etc/timezone", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            candidates.append(fh.read().strip())
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            ["timedatectl", "show", "-p", "Timezone", "--value"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5,
        )
        if out.returncode == 0 and out.stdout.strip():
            candidates.append(out.stdout.strip())
    except Exception:
        pass
    for name in candidates:
        try:
            ZoneInfo(name)
            return name
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None


def next_monday_after(today):
    """The Monday of next week (strictly after today)."""
    delta = (7 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if delta == 0:
        delta = 7
    return today + timedelta(days=delta)


def fmt_offset(off):
    total = int(off.total_seconds())
    sign = "+" if total >= 0 else "-"
    total = abs(total)
    return "%s%02d%02d" % (sign, total // 3600, (total % 3600) // 60)


def build_vtimezone(tz, year):
    """Build a VTIMEZONE component for `tz` covering `year` (stdlib only)."""
    zone_lines = ["BEGIN:VTIMEZONE", "TZID:%s" % tz.key]
    start_utc = datetime(year, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    end_utc = datetime(year + 1, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    # Hourly probes in UTC; offset changes between probes mark transitions.
    probes = []
    cur = start_utc
    while cur <= end_utc:
        local = cur.astimezone(tz)
        probes.append((cur, cur.utcoffset(), bool(tz.dst(local))))
        cur += timedelta(hours=1)

    segments = []  # (dtstart_naive_in_old_wall, off_from, off_to, is_dst)
    prev_off = probes[0][1]
    prev_wall = (probes[0][0] + prev_off).replace(tzinfo=None)
    for utc_dt, off, is_dst in probes[1:]:
        if off != prev_off:
            wall = (prev_wall + timedelta(hours=1)).replace(tzinfo=None)
            segments.append((wall, prev_off, off, is_dst))
            prev_off = off
        prev_wall = (utc_dt + off).replace(tzinfo=None)

    real_transitions = bool(segments)
    if not segments:  # e.g. UTC: no offset changes all year
        jan_off = probes[0][1]
        segments = [(
            datetime(year, 1, 1),
            jan_off,
            jan_off,
            bool(tz.dst(datetime(year, 1, 1, tzinfo=tz))),
        )]

    for dtstart, off_from, off_to, is_dst in segments:
        kind = "DAYLIGHT" if is_dst else "STANDARD"
        month = dtstart.month
        wd = ["MO", "TU", "WE", "TH", "FR", "SA", "SU"][dtstart.weekday()]
        first = date(dtstart.year, dtstart.month, 1)
        first_wd = first.weekday()
        pos = (dtstart.day - 1 - ((dtstart.weekday() - first_wd) % 7)) // 7 + 1
        dim = _cal.monthrange(dtstart.year, dtstart.month)[1]
        if dtstart.day + 7 > dim:
            pos = -1
        zone_lines.append("BEGIN:%s" % kind)
        zone_lines.append("DTSTART:%s" % dtstart.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"))
        if real_transitions:
            zone_lines.append("RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=%d;BYDAY=%d%s" % (month, pos, wd))
        zone_lines.append("TZOFFSETFROM:%s" % fmt_offset(off_from))
        zone_lines.append("TZOFFSETTO:%s" % fmt_offset(off_to))
        zone_lines.append("END:%s" % kind)
    zone_lines.append("END:VTIMEZONE")
    return "\r\n".join(zone_lines)


def generate_manual_ics(start, end, tz_name, tz, now_utc):
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    ]
    use_tzid = bool(tz_name) and tz_name != "UTC"
    if use_tzid:
        lines.append(build_vtimezone(tz, start.year))
    lines.append("BEGIN:VEVENT")
    lines.append("UID:%s@calendar-skill" % uuid.uuid4())
    lines.append("DTSTAMP:%s" % now_utc.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"))
    if use_tzid:
        lines.append("DTSTART;TZID=%s:%s" % (tz_name, start.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")))
        lines.append("DTEND;TZID=%s:%s" % (tz_name, end.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")))
    else:
        lines.append("DTSTART:%s" % start.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"))
        lines.append("DTEND:%s" % end.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"))
    lines.append("SUMMARY:%s" % SUMMARY)
    lines.append("DESCRIPTION:%s" % DESCRIPTION)
    lines.append("STATUS:%s" % STATUS)
    lines.append("SEQUENCE:0")
    lines.append("END:VEVENT")
    lines.append("END:VCALENDAR")
    return ("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n").encode("utf-8")


def main():
    today = date.today()
    kickoff = next_monday_after(today)

    tz_name = get_local_tz_name()
    tz = None
    if tz_name:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
        tz = ZoneInfo(tz_name)
    if tz is None:
        tz = timezone.utc
        tz_name = "UTC"

    start = datetime(kickoff.year, kickoff.month, kickoff.day, 10, 0, tzinfo=tz)
    end = start + timedelta(hours=2)
    now_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    data = None
    used = None
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar, Event
        cal = Calendar()
        cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN")
        cal.add("version", "2.0")
        ev = Event()
        ev.add("summary", SUMMARY)
        ev.add("description", DESCRIPTION)
        ev.add("dtstart", start)
        ev.add("dtend", end)
        ev.add("dtstamp", now_utc)
        ev.add("uid", "%s@calendar-skill" % uuid.uuid4())
        ev.add("status", STATUS)
        ev.add("sequence", 0)
        cal.add_component(ev)
        data = cal.to_ical()
        used = "icalendar"
    except Exception as exc:
        print("icalendar unavailable (%s); using stdlib manual generation" % exc)
        data = generate_manual_ics(start, end, tz_name, tz, now_utc)
        used = "manual"

    path = os.path.abspath(OUTPUT)
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(data)

    # --- Summary ---
    print("Generated with: %s" % used)
    print("Today: %s (%s)" % (today.isoformat(), today.strftime("%A")))
    print("Kickoff date: %s (%s)" % (kickoff.isoformat(), kickoff.strftime("%A")))
    print("Timezone: %s" % tz_name)
    print("Start: %s" % start.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"))
    print("End:   %s" % end.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"))
    print("Duration: %s" % (end - start))
    print("File: %s" % path)

    # --- Validation ---
    if used == "icalendar":
        from icalendar import Calendar as Parser
        parsed = Parser.from_ical(data)
        ok = False
        for comp in parsed.walk():
            if comp.name == "VEVENT":
                print("Validation: parsed OK")
                print("  Event: %s" % comp.get("summary"))
                print("  Start: %s" % comp.get("dtstart").dt)
                print("  End:   %s" % comp.get("dtend").dt)
                print("  UID:   %s" % comp.get("uid"))
                ok = True
        print("Validation: VEVENT present: %s" % ok)
    else:
        text = data.decode("utf-8")
        required = [
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "PRODID",
            "BEGIN:VEVENT", "UID", "DTSTAMP", "DTSTART", "DTEND",
            "SUMMARY", "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR",
        ]
        missing = [c for c in required if c not in text]
        print("Validation: %s" % ("OK" if not missing else "MISSING: %s" % missing))

    print("--- ICS content ---")
    print(data.decode("utf-8"), end="")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import calendar as _cal
import os
import subprocess
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

OUTPUT = "project_kickoff.ics"
SUMMARY = "Project Kickoff Meeting"
DESCRIPTION = "Kickoff meeting for the new project."
STATUS = "CONFIRMED"


def get_local_tz_name():
    """Best-effort detection of the system's IANA timezone name."""
    try:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
    except ImportError:
        return None
    candidates = []
    try:
        with open("/etc/timezone", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            candidates.append(fh.read().strip())
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            ["timedatectl", "show", "-p", "Timezone", "--value"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5,
        )
        if out.returncode == 0 and out.stdout.strip():
            candidates.append(out.stdout.strip())
    except Exception:
        pass
    for name in candidates:
        try:
            ZoneInfo(name)
            return name
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None


def next_monday_after(today):
    """The Monday of next week (strictly after today)."""
    delta = (7 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if delta == 0:
        delta = 7
    return today + timedelta(days=delta)


def fmt_offset(off):
    total = int(off.total_seconds())
    sign = "+" if total >= 0 else "-"
    total = abs(total)
    return "%s%02d%02d" % (sign, total // 3600, (total % 3600) // 60)


def build_vtimezone(tz, year):
    """Build a VTIMEZONE component for `tz` covering `year` (stdlib only)."""
    zone_lines = ["BEGIN:VTIMEZONE", "TZID:%s" % tz.key]
    start_utc = datetime(year, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    end_utc = datetime(year + 1, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    # Hourly probes in UTC; the LOCAL offset changes between probes mark
    # transitions (DST switches).
    probes = []
    cur = start_utc
    while cur <= end_utc:
        local = cur.astimezone(tz)
        probes.append((cur, local.utcoffset(), bool(tz.dst(local))))
        cur += timedelta(hours=1)

    segments = []  # (dtstart_naive_in_old_wall, off_from, off_to, is_dst)
    prev_off = probes[0][1]
    prev_wall = (probes[0][0] + prev_off).replace(tzinfo=None)
    for utc_dt, off, is_dst in probes[1:]:
        if off != prev_off:
            wall = (prev_wall + timedelta(hours=1)).replace(tzinfo=None)
            segments.append((wall, prev_off, off, is_dst))
            prev_off = off
        prev_wall = (utc_dt + off).replace(tzinfo=None)

    real_transitions = bool(segments)
    if not segments:  # constant-offset zone (e.g. UTC, Asia/Shanghai)
        jan_off = probes[0][1]
        segments = [(
            datetime(year, 1, 1),
            jan_off,
            jan_off,
            bool(tz.dst(datetime(year, 1, 1, tzinfo=tz))),
        )]

    for dtstart, off_from, off_to, is_dst in segments:
        kind = "DAYLIGHT" if is_dst else "STANDARD"
        month = dtstart.month
        wd = ["MO", "TU", "WE", "TH", "FR", "SA", "SU"][dtstart.weekday()]

            pos = -1
        zone_lines.append("BEGIN:%s" % kind)

        if real_transitions:
            zone_lines.append("RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=%d;BYDAY=%d%s" % (month, pos, wd))
        zone_lines.append("TZOFFSETFROM:%s" % fmt_offset(off_from))
        zone_lines.append("TZOFFSETTO:%s" % fmt_offset(off_to))
        zone_lines.append("END:%s" % kind)
    zone_lines.append("END:VTIMEZONE")
    return "\r\n".join(zone_lines)
